The current slugify implementation replaces all non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens, which causes 'Python 3.10' to become 'python-3-10' instead of 'python-310'. To fix this, first remove all non-alphanumeric and non-space characters, then replace spaces with hyphens. Update slugify as follows:

def slugify(text, max_length=None):
    text = text.lower()
    text = ''.join(c for c in unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', text) if unicodedata.category(c) != 'Mn')
    # Remove all non-alnum and non-space characters
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9 ]+', '', text)
    # Replace spaces with hyphens
    text = re.sub(r' +', '-', text)
    text = text.strip('-')
    text = re.sub(r'-+', '-', text)
    if max_length is not None:
        if len(text) > max_length:
            text = text[:max_length]
        if text.endswith('-'):
            text = text[:-1]
    return text
